description: The file 'App.tsx' is a main React component for a Next.js frontend project that manages a workflow for generating user personas from uploaded documents. It includes UI for uploading files, displaying the persona, editing details, progressing through steps, and finalizing a persona, with state management and API calls integrated.

methods.name: mapDraftToPersonaData
methods.description: Maps draft data to the personaData object for rendering.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds uploaded files to the current list.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles files dropped into a drop zone.

methods.name: handleDragOver
methods.description: Manages drag-over events for file upload UI.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a selected file from the list.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Initiates generation of a persona draft based on uploaded files.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves edits made to the persona.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a skill from the persona's skill list.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the persona's skill list.

methods.name: handleProfileImageChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the profile image upload.
